question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The given answer is **"element".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"element".**
 
• The word **"element"** refers to a fundamental or essential part or aspect of something. (अंश)
 
 
• **Example:** *Fitness has now become an important **element **in our lives.*
 
 
 
• The word** "element" **is used here to refer to these essential components or parts of a healthy eating plan.
 
• Hence, **"element"** should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

**Completed Sentence: ***A healthy diet is (1) ** rich __** in fibre, whole grains, fresh fruits and vegetables, "good" or unsaturated fats, and omega-3 fatty acids. These dietary components turn down inflammation, which can (2)**__ damage __** tissue, joints, artery walls and organs. Going easy on processed foods is another (3)**__ element __**of healthy eating. Sweets, foods made with highly refined grains, and sugar-sweetened beverages can (4)_________ spikes in blood sugar that can lead to early hunger. High blood sugar is (5)_________ the development of diabetes, obesity, heart disease and even dementia.*
